content.value: In a deflection type Wheatstone bridge arrangement shown in figure, the resistances of 09 various arms are P=1000 Ω, Q=100 Ω, R=2005 Ω, and S=200 Ω. The battery has an emf of 5 V. The voltmeter used to the arrangement has span 0 V to 5 V, sensitivity of 20000 Ω/V and resolution of 1 mV.
i) What will be the voltage difference between point a and b?
ii) What will be the voltmeter reading?
iii) How the bridge can be balanced?
